study_identification_part.si_4_title: Multiscale heterogeneity of functional connectivity in autism

nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: Gaussian process regression normative models for each inter-regional functional connectivity estimate.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: We used gaussian process regression, as described by (Marquand et al., 2016), to fit separate normative models to each of 75,855 FC estimates between each pair of 390 brain regions, using age, sex, and mean framewise displacement.

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: Inter-regional resting-state functional connectivity estimates (pairwise correlations).
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text:
Resting-state fMRI and structural scans were obtained using 3T MRI scanners at 32 scanning sites.
To map inter-regional FC, we used the well-validated Schaefer parcellation (Schaefer et al., 2018) to obtain 400 functional cortical regions of interest (ROIs) for each participant.
